start: Menu More, Trainers; the gym is online, its server has trainer pages, two staff carry the Trainer tick

user_sees: Title 'Trainers', subtitle 'Your trainers, their hours, and personal-training bookings'

One card per trainer: photo or initials, name, 'Teaches: <words>' or 'What they teach is not added yet', 'Today: <hours>' (or 'Working hours not set', or 'Day off'), '<n> personal-training members', button 'Open page'
must_not: A staff person without the Trainer tick shown as a trainer
'1 personal-training members'

user_sees: Buttons 'Last week' and 'Next week'
Seven day chips, each with its number of bookings
'<Day>: <bookings words>. Tap a free time to book.'
A grid: 'Time' down the side, one column per trainer; cells say 'Free', a member’s name (booked), 'Off', or are striped (already over)
A key: 'Free to book', 'Booked', 'Not working', 'Already over'
Button 'Book personal training'
must_not: A time already past shown as 'Free' for today
A day chip cut off or hidden at the edge on a phone
A booking drawn in the wrong trainer’s column

user_sees: Title = the trainer’s name, subtitle 'Trainer', button 'All trainers'
'Working hours' with one row per day
'Personal-training members' with '<classes left> · <booked>' per member, or the no-members words
'Bookings this week' (or 'No bookings this week.') and the button 'Book with <name>'
must_not: Another trainer’s members or bookings on this page

start: Other entry: the week buttons of the calendar (Trainers.tsx:378)

user_sees: The title changes to 'Personal training, week of <date>'
A third button 'This week'
The first day of that week is picked; its grid shows
must_not: Bookings of this week left in next week’s grid
A day picked that is not in the shown week

user_sees: Last week’s days; every cell without a booking is striped 'Already over'
must_not: A 'Free' cell that can be tapped in a past week

user_sees: Today picked again, title 'Personal training this week'
must_not: The grid stuck on the other week

start: Other entry: a trainer’s page opened straight from its address (Trainers.tsx:792)

steps.action: Open /trainers/<staff id> of a current trainer
user_sees: That trainer’s page with hours, members and this week’s bookings
must_not: The list of all trainers instead
A blank page while loading with no 'Loading…'

steps.action: Tap a member’s name under 'Personal-training members'
user_sees: That member’s page
must_not: A member of another gym

start: Negative: the screen cannot show trainers

steps.action: Open Trainers in a gym whose server does not have trainer pages yet
user_sees: 'Trainer pages are not ready for your gym yet'
'MettleUp has not switched on trainer pages and personal-training bookings for your gym yet. Nothing you do here is saved. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp if you want it for your gym.'
must_not: A calendar that looks usable but saves nothing
A 'Try again' button that can never help

steps.action: Open Trainers in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Trainer pages need your gym online'
'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Open Trainers when the load fails
user_sees: 'Could not load your trainers', the reason in plain words, and 'Try again'
must_not: A raw error code
An empty trainers list presented as the truth

steps.action: Open Trainers when nobody carries the Trainer tick
user_sees: 'No trainers yet'
Owner: 'Open Staff & sign-in and tick "Trainer" next to each trainer. They show here with their own page.' and the button 'Open Staff & sign-in'
Not the owner: 'The gym owner picks the trainers in Staff & sign-in. They show here with their own page.' and no button
must_not: The 'Open Staff & sign-in' button for someone who may not open it

start: State: a trainer loses the Trainer tick

steps.action: With a trainer’s page open, the owner takes off that person’s Trainer tick; reload the page
user_sees: 'This trainer is not on your list any more'
'The owner may have taken off their Trainer tick.'
must_not: The old page with an Edit button for a person who is no longer a trainer

user_sees: The person is gone from the cards and from the grid’s columns
must_not: unknown risk to check: that person’s future bookings left where nobody can see or cancel them

steps.action: The owner ticks them again; open Trainers
user_sees: The trainer is back with the same 'Teaches' words, hours and photo as before
must_not: A page that lost its hours or photo

start: Privacy and promise: who sees a trainer’s page and the members on it

steps.action: Sign in as a desk person who is not a trainer and open a trainer’s page
user_sees: The trainer’s photo, what they teach, hours, their personal-training members by name with classes left, and the week’s bookings
No 'Edit page' button
must_not: 'Edit page' for someone who is neither the owner nor that trainer
Members’ phone numbers on this page

steps.action: Sign in as that trainer and open the same page
user_sees: The same page with 'Edit page'
must_not: 'Edit page' on another trainer’s page
